subtitle.ja: 京都駅から清水寺、伏見稲荷、祇園、東福寺、嵐山へ。紅葉と雪の夕暮れを、歩いて、空から
subtitle.en: From Kyoto Station to Kiyomizu-dera, Fushimi Inari, Gion, Tōfuku-ji and Arashiyama: an autumn evening and a snowy one, on foot and from the air

summary.ja: 京都駅を中心に伏見稲荷から銀閣寺までの約5.8×8.6kmと、金閣寺、嵐山・嵯峨野を3Dで再現し、歩いて、空から巡ります。千本鳥居をくぐり、三十三間堂で千体の千手観音と二十八部衆、風神・雷神の前を歩き、清水の舞台や東福寺の通天橋から紅葉の谷を見下ろし、東寺の五重塔、祇園、永観堂、竹林の小径、渡月橋へ。季節は紅葉の秋と15cmほど雪の積もった冬、時刻は夕暮れ。街はPLATEAU（国土交通省）・OpenStreetMap・国土地理院の標高データから生成し、名所はBlenderで手作りしたモデル。光はBlenderで焼き込み、WebGPUで描画。BGMはバッハ《ゴルトベルク変奏曲》をゆっくり弾くブラウザ内合成のピアノ。日本語と英語に対応。WebGPU対応ブラウザ向け、初回読み込みは約160MB（残りは巡りながら読み込みます）。
summary.en: About 5.8 by 8.6 km of Kyoto around the station, from Fushimi Inari to Ginkaku-ji, plus Kinkaku-ji and Arashiyama–Sagano, rebuilt in 3D to walk or fly over: through the thousand torii, past the thousand Kannon of Sanjūsangen-dō with its 28 guardians and the gods of wind and thunder, out on the Kiyomizu stage and Tōfuku-ji's Tsūten-kyō above valleys of maples, to Tō-ji's pagoda, Gion, Eikandō, the bamboo grove and the Togetsu-kyō. An autumn evening and a snowy one (15 cm). The city is generated from PLATEAU (MLIT), OpenStreetMap and GSI elevation data; the landmarks are modelled by hand in Blender. Light baked in Blender, drawn with WebGPU. Bach's Goldberg Variations, played slowly by a piano synthesised in the browser. Japanese and English. Needs a WebGPU browser; the first load is about 160 MB (the rest streams in as you go).
